verifiedSurfaceSummary: Verified on Saturday, July 25, 2026 that https://www.springboard.com/join-us/ is Springboard's first-party careers page and identifies the company as an education provider with offices in Bengaluru. That page links candidates to Springboard's public Greenhouse board at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/springboard. The verified public Greenhouse feed exposed nine roles under the exact board identity Springboard Roles, all in United States or unspecified Remote locations. Because Springboard's first-party page returns HTTP 403 to this scraper, the runtime uses only the official Greenhouse API and fails closed if its company identity, payload shape, or canonical detail URLs change.
